title: Component-Perfect Multidimensional Discrete Morse Functions
summary: We introduce the concept of component-perfect multidimensional discrete Morse (MDM) functions on finite regular CW complexes. While perfect discrete Morse functions in the classical sense require the number of critical cells of index $p$ to exactly equal the $p$-th Betti number, the multiparameter framework necessitates a topological dynamics perspective, where critical cells naturally cluster into connected components.
